findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: There is soil residue observed under the racks where sausage is stored in the display cooler. This was discussed with the PIC. The PIC instructed an employee to clean this area. Ensure that non-food contact surfaces are cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Inspector observed 22 cans to be rusted, severely dented, or dented along a seam. Discussed with PIC, and all cans were disposed of immediately. Ensure that dented (sharp dent or seam dent), rusted, or bulged cans are thrown away and not sold to customers.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Inspector observed 4 papayas and several yellow summer squashes to be molding on the retail shelf. Discussed with PIC and all moldy foods were discarded. Ensure that moldy food is removed from shelves and not sold to customers.
findings.citation_text: 3-101.11 Safe, Unadulterated, and Honestly Presented. FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, as specified under § 3-601.12, honestly presented.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Bakery line hand sink was observed to need caulk along the top of the sink.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure sink is caulked to prevent mold growth between sink and wall and to create a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
No paper towels were available at time of inspection.  Discussed with PIC, the dispenser was filled on-site.  Ensure hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Bakery line sink was observed to need caulk along the top of the sink.  Discussed with PIC, who will contact maintenance.  Ensure sink is caulked to prevent mold growth between sink and wall.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Fan grates in walk-in cooler were observed to contain an accumulation of dust.  Discussed with PIC, who will contact maintenance.  Ensure grates in walk-in cooler and freezer are cleaned regularly to prevent dust accumulation.

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed a container stored on the shelf with no label that contains a white substance. Provide a label on all unmistakable powders. An employee provided a label during the inspection to correct the violation.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
CORRECTED: Observed no chlorine test kits during the time of the inspection. Provide chlorine test kits near the three compartment sink. A container of chlorine test kits were provided during the inspection to correct the violation.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
CORRECTED - Observe many boxes of single-use items stacked and stored on the floor. Raise on carts or pallets to keep off of the floor.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: Floors are soiled. 750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: The cold case holding icing does not have a thermometer. 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F. Provide thermometer in this cooling unit.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: The decorating tips are drying on a paper towel and there are parchment papers under the icing cooking wells that appear to be used for drying bowls over.  750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.  Do not use absorbent surfaces for drip drying.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: A box of single use containers is on the floor of the bakery. 750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law. Carton of containers was moved up onto the table.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: Ceiling of bakery walk in freezer has frost gathering on it. 750-1210(b) Walls and ceilings in walk-in refrigeration units, food preparation areas, equipment washing areas, and toilet rooms shall be smooth, light-cored, non-absorbent, and easily cleansable. Concrete or pumice block in these locations shall be finished and sealed to provide a cleansable surface. Clean ceiling.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed two unlabeled spray bottles of water.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.
Corrected: The bottles were labeled.  Label secondary containers with the common name of the contents of the container.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
Observed a bucket in a hand sink.
750-1120(b) Lavatories shall be accessible to employees at all times.
Corrected: the bucket was moved.  Do not block the hand sink.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed food crumbs inside and on the storage containers.  Clean the containers and maintain clean.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed improperly stored sample spoons.  Store the spoons with the handle extended.  Corrected: the spoons were discarded.
750-880 Single-service knives, forks and spoons packaged in bulk shall be inserted into holders to protect these items from contamination and present the handle of the utensils to the consumer unless the utensils are pre-wrapped or pre-packaged.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed metal bowls stored face up under a prep table. Section 750.850 Store bowls face down as not to contaminate. (CORRECTED)
